lpml.title: C++
lpml.p: C++ is a high-level programming language based on \page:C\. In the 1990s, C++ became one of the most used programming languages in the world. Like C, C++ uses manual memory management, and largely shares the same syntax with C, although there are some differences.
The C++ programming language was developed by Bjarne Stroustrup at Bell Labs in the 1980s, and was originally named "C with classes".
The below example code only works on C++23 or later and is the "modern" way.
Though, the older way still works and will continue to work in future versions.
